advice_items.quote: the worst thing you can have is Plan B. Plan B is the largest enemy to Plan A, it takes away focus from Plan A
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid having a Plan B because it steals focus from making Plan A succeed.
advice_items.summary_zh: 专注A计划，别留B计划分散精力

advice_items.quote: they don't understand cash flow... a lot of businesses will grow fast and thinking they're successful and they outstrip their capital
advice_items.summary_en: Understand cash flow and the financial side so rapid growth does not outstrip your capital.
advice_items.summary_zh: 懂现金流，别因扩张过快耗尽资本

advice_items.canonical_tag: Be Careful Who You Partner With
advice_items.quote: don't let any investor be too big or otherwise you're working for them
advice_items.summary_en: Do not let any single investor hold too much leverage or you end up working for them.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别让单一投资人占股过大而失去控制权

advice_items.quote: get to the gym every day and eat well
advice_items.summary_en: Go to the gym every day and eat well to maintain health and energy as you age.
advice_items.summary_zh: 每天坚持去健身房锻炼并健康饮食

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Wait Too Long to Start / Invest
advice_items.quote: go out on my own sooner than I did
advice_items.summary_en: He wishes he had gone out on his own and started his own business sooner.
advice_items.summary_zh: 后悔没有比当年更早出来独立创业

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.quote: not everybody's built for it, but if you want to make real money you usually have to make it working for yourself
advice_items.summary_en: While entrepreneurship is not for everyone, making real wealth usually requires working for yourself.
advice_items.summary_zh: 想赚大钱通常必须靠自己创业持有股权

advice_items.quote: walk away. The best deals I've done in my life I've walked away and they've come back
advice_items.summary_en: Be willing to walk away during negotiations; the best deals often come back to you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 谈判最好的策略是敢于主动起身离开

guests.first_money_or_break: 早年曾经历经济拮据，随后在银行业深耕44年，主要通过收购银行并削减冗余成本实现规模化扩张，将旗下业务做到年营收约5亿美元。
guests.role_or_title: Bank Owner & Executive (44 years in banking)
guests.zero_start_advice: 尽早独立创业，全力聚焦A计划而不留退路，牢牢掌握现金流避免盲目扩张耗尽资本，融资时避免让单一投资人话语权过大，并在谈判中敢于离场。

advice_items.quote: they have a great product or service but they don't know how to manage cash flow
advice_items.summary_en: Even with a great product or service, businesses fail within five years if owners cannot manage cash flow.
advice_items.summary_zh: 企业有好产品但往往不懂管理现金流

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Cast a Clear Vision for Your Team
advice_items.quote: casting a vision for a team, small team to make it into a large team, that this is where we are but this is where we're going, follow me
advice_items.summary_en: Master casting a compelling vision to align and grow a small team into a large organization.
advice_items.summary_zh: 为团队描绘清晰愿景并带领从小做大

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.quote: retained equity in our company... the 7 or 8 million came through dividends on the equity that we owned because we were so profitable
advice_items.summary_en: Retaining equity in a profitable company generates far greater wealth through dividends than salary and bonuses alone.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保留公司股权靠利润分红实现千万收益

advice_items.quote: love what you do and you'll never work a day in your life
advice_items.summary_en: Love what you do so your career never feels like a chore.
advice_items.summary_zh: 热爱自己所做的事就不会觉得在工作

advice_items.canonical_tag: Work Under a Winner First Before Starting
advice_items.quote: I learned my trade in 10 years working for the big firms and then next 20, 25 years I built my own companies
advice_items.summary_en: Spend years learning your trade at established firms before launching and building your own companies.
advice_items.summary_zh: 先在大公司磨炼十年再出来创业二十年

advice_items.quote: most fail, but you have to have the burn the ships mentality—there is no retreat and you're taking the island
advice_items.summary_en: Adopt a burn-the-ships mentality with no retreat if you want to beat the odds in entrepreneurship.
advice_items.summary_zh: 创业必须有破釜沉舟、不留退路的心态

guests.first_money_or_break: 白手起家，先在大企业工作10年磨炼专业能力，随后花20至25年创办并经营自己的咨询与服务公司，依靠保留公司股权和分红实现个人年入800万至1000万美元。
guests.wealth_detail: $8M-$10M/yr personal income ($500k salary, $250k bonus, $7M-$8M equity dividends)
guests.zero_start_advice: 先在大公司打工积累十年行业经验再出来自主创业，保留企业股权获取利润分红，学会管理现金流并为团队树立清晰愿景，以破釜沉舟的决心热爱并投入事业。

advice_items.quote: I bought a franchise so that somebody else would do the heavy thinking; all I had to do is run the restaurants
advice_items.summary_en: Buying into a proven franchise lets someone else handle concept development so you can focus purely on execution.
advice_items.summary_zh: 加盟成熟品牌让他人承担研发与试错

advice_items.quote: they don't build a team that supports them and they think they're king and they don't think the other people matter
advice_items.summary_en: Build a supportive team and value every person rather than acting like an arrogant king.
advice_items.summary_zh: 组建支持团队，别自大以为别人不重要

advice_items.quote: don't rush into owning your own business if you can work for the other guy... owning your own business you have to put your house up
advice_items.summary_en: Do not rush into business ownership and put your house and assets on the line if you can build a lucrative career working for someone else.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别急着抵押房产创业，可先为他人打工

advice_items.quote: choose the right life partner... you got to have support at home
advice_items.summary_en: Choose a supportive life partner, because misery at home ruins your work life and health.
advice_items.summary_zh: 选对支持自己的人生伴侣至关重要

advice_items.canonical_tag: Don't Neglect Health & Family for Money
advice_items.quote: if you're just working to work then your health will be crap
advice_items.summary_en: Do not work endlessly just for the sake of working at the expense of your health.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别只顾着盲目工作而拖垮自己的健康

advice_items.quote: I go long on real estate, real estate never goes down... owned the properties instead of leasing and renting, they bought the land, so own that and don't sell it
advice_items.summary_en: Buy and hold real estate and land long-term instead of leasing, and never sell it.
advice_items.summary_zh: 长期投资房地产，买下土地物业别卖出

guests.first_money_or_break: 出身普通工薪家庭（父亲病弱无法工作，母亲在药店做柜台店员），从职业体系一路晋升担任TGI Fridays首席执行官，同时购入Golden Chick特许经营权及门店物业地产。
guests.guest_name: Former TGI Fridays CEO & Golden Chick Franchisee
guests.role_or_title: Former TGI Fridays CEO & Golden Chick Franchisee (age 70+)
guests.zero_start_advice: 不必急于拿全部家当冒险创业，可先在企业担任高管或借助成熟特许经营体系专注执行；选对家庭伴侣并注重健康，同时长期买下并持有房地产与土地。

advice_items.quote: you're better off investing back into you, invest back into your own business... skills, associations, relationships, reputation, that's what it means to invest back into yourself
advice_items.summary_en: To double your money, invest back into your own business, skills, associations, relationships, and reputation rather than handing it to Wall Street.
advice_items.summary_zh: 将资金投资回自身技能人脉声誉与事业

advice_items.quote: when you're in the worst position you're actually in the best position, that's when God shows up... you sometimes forget where your blessings and your resources come from
advice_items.summary_en: Stay grounded in faith and gratitude during both rock-bottom moments and peak success, never taking sole credit for your blessings.
advice_items.summary_zh: 身处低谷时保持信仰与感恩，别忘恩负义

advice_items.quote: number one they ask the most questions... number two they go into a room not thinking that they know everything
advice_items.summary_en: Ask the most questions and enter every room with intellectual humility, assuming you might be wrong so you can learn.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持谦逊并多提问，不自以为无所不知

advice_items.quote: everybody that had a fun lifestyle 2, 3, 4 years ago and they didn't save money, they're selling it right now 20, 30, 40, 50% discount
advice_items.summary_en: Do not finance an unaffordable luxury lifestyle without saving, or downturns and high rates will force you to liquidate at steep losses.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别在繁荣期不存钱而透支维持奢华生活

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.quote: during times of good be the guy that stacks cash, when times are great be the one that constantly puts money away... waiting for opportunities
advice_items.summary_en: Stack cash aggressively during good economic times so you have dry powder to buy discounted assets when others are forced to sell.
advice_items.summary_zh: 顺境时积极储备现金，等待低谷抄底机会

guests.first_money_or_break: 曾在海军陆战队服役8年，退伍后创业25年深耕金融与保险行业；30多岁首次成为百万富翁，随后破产两三次，40多岁东山再起，旗下业务年营收达4000万美元（且曾有部分业务被以300万美元收购）。
guests.zero_start_advice: 把资本投回自身的技能、人脉、关系和声誉以及自己的事业中；保持信仰与谦逊，向高手多提问；经济顺境时克制消费、积极存钱，等待危机时抄底被低价抛售的资产。
